config.receiver_design: HFM envelope acquisition; independent known-tone Doppler pilots; fractional-time payload correction

frame_energy: All received clean slot energy includes HFM, new known-tone pilots, payload and multipath tail.
sample_snr_packet: variance=received_energy_samples/ceil(alpha*(packet_duration+0.128)*fs)/10^(label/10); random listening padding excluded from denominator
ebn0_received: variance=received_energy_samples/(2*64*10^(label/10)); preamble and pilot energy included per information bit
noise_pairing: Same standard-normal vector for both noise definitions and all active/guard choices at matched channel/record/slot/label
phase: One uniform random phase per packet, symbol-reset modulation; phase/payload/jitter matched across active/guard choices
capture_loss: Receiver reports no complete decoded payload; one packet per slot. This is not a separate verified timing-association metric.
truth_isolation: Truth only in waveform generation, channel/noise scaling and scoring; receive_packet sees rx, cfg and 64
scope: Development records 001-003 only; descriptive alignment sensitivity, no exact-replication or independent-test claim
resume: Deterministic per-configuration CSV checkpoints; completed conditions are preserved across process restarts
